posts.title: You Look Good In Anything
posts.description: I started hearing this phrase when I grew into my teens, no longer something small and cute, but a gangly thing with a pretty face. No matter how awkward the form I took, it was enough to be desired. I heard it first on an unusually chilly day during the amihan season. I came to school wearing the black cardigan I loved.
